description: This file serves as the server-side rendering (SSR) entry point for a Qwik-based web application. It imports necessary functions and components, and defines a default export function that renders the Root component to a stream, configuring options such as manifest, container attributes, and server data.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Exports a default function that processes rendering options to generate a server-side rendering stream for the Root component with specified configurations.
